title: [France] train_s3: digit structure and address-number behaviour
filename_note: analysis_out/tasks/P033.json names P033_France_train_s3_numeric.md; the work order names P033_France_train_s3_digits.md as EXACT. Work order followed.

code_confirmation: decoy_postfilter.py:17-18 names France as a country with no training labels
build_profile.py:61-62 country_rows is a Counter; line 142 emits dict(country_rows); a zero-count country produces NO key

digit_structure_train_s3.semantics_note: num_digits = ADDRESS only (build_profile.py:114). dig5/dig6 are lookaround-guarded (?<!\d)\d{5}(?!\d) at build_profile.py:29-30. All fields are slice totals; rates = value / rows. alpha_only_addr = rows whose address has no digit at all (build_profile.py:117-118).

France.verdict: UNDEFINED - 0 rows in train_s3, every rate is 0/0

us_pin_asymmetry_does_hold_for_s3.verdict: YES - train_s3 groups with train_s2, not train_s1
us_pin_asymmetry_does_hold_for_s3.conclusion: dig5/row is FLAT across all three US train sources; only the 6-digit/pin structure shifts. s3 does not reproduce the source-1 deficit.
us_pin_asymmetry_does_hold_for_s3.note: Mechanism not re-derived; already-covered finding. Confirmation only, as the work order requested.

pure_digit_token_ladder_train_s3.caveat: top-4000 bag only -> LOWER BOUNDS. Floor: US 440, India 362.
pure_digit_token_ladder_train_s3.cliff_interpretation: L5/L6 = 0 in the bag is a TRUNCATION artefact, not absence. Lower bounds on distinct 5-digit values: US ceil(341738/440)=777, India ceil(22317/362)=62.
pure_digit_token_ladder_train_s3.shape: house/street-number field, not a postcode - consistent with the settled 'no country has a postal field' conclusion

s3_state_representation_shift.headline: s3 inverts the state representation, and it does so in OPPOSITE directions for the two countries
s3_state_representation_shift.label: CONFIRMED

India.direction: s1/s2 write the state in FULL; s3 writes the 2-letter CODE

US.direction: s1/s2 write the 2-letter CODE; s3 writes the state in FULL - THE REVERSE of India
US.corroboration: ny 77.32 -> 3.66 per 1k while new 10.30 -> 88.07 per 1k (s3 writes 'New York'); ca 28.25 -> 1.32 and california 0.43 -> 26.36 per 1k
US.note: D118 measured the India direction only. This US direction is NEW and not previously recorded.

s3_state_representation_shift.conclusion: s3 is not 'shorter addresses'; it is a different geography encoding whose direction depends on the country. A 's3 is compressed' intuition is wrong for the US.

self_map_loop_exposure.correction_to_D118: D118's 98.00% (3,125,112 of 3,188,831) is an IN_STATES-only statistic. US_STATES runs the opposite way (5.91% in s3). The pooled 33.77% is a meaningless average of two opposite effects.

real_exposure.basis: mass sitting in files that WRITE 2-LETTER CODES, because those are the files with no blocking-key fallback
real_exposure.verdict: CONFIRMED. A 'tidy up the redundant bare-code keys' refactor would silently delete the state feature for 10,044,348 occurrences across BOTH countries.
real_exposure.action: DO NOT refactor. No change recommended.

blocking_key_asymmetry.label: CONFIRMED as a code-path asymmetry; scoring impact NOT measurable from this profile
mechanism: keys.py:42 requires str.len_chars() >= 3 to enter alph
all 36 IN_STATES and all 51 US_STATES canonical values are exactly 2 characters (verified against normalize.py:216-242; zero codes with len < 3)
no state code collides with any of the 62 ADDR_GENERIC entries (keys.py:14-19), so the earlier filter rescues nothing; len >= 3 is the sole blocker
blocking_key_asymmetry.consequence: a 2-letter state token can never become a blocking key of any kind (0, 1, 2, 3 or 4). The only carrier is the state field, reaching the model solely via state_eq (features.py:114, tri(q_state,s_state)) - a 3-way {-1,0,1} feature, NOT a retrieval route.
blocking_key_asymmetry.both_ways: normalize.py:333-335 requires the WHOLE comma-component to equal the key; on success the component is CONSUMED (continue) and never appended to toks. On failure it falls through into toks and is then killed by len >= 3. Either way no blocking key exists.
blocking_key_asymmetry.asymmetry: s3 Indian state resolution rests ENTIRELY on the state field with zero blocking redundancy, whereas train_s1/train_s2 write 'maharashtra' (10 chars), which WOULD retain a length>=3 blocking token even if the dictionary missed.
blocking_key_asymmetry.direction_note: US s3 writes 'texas' (5 chars), which WOULD survive keys.py:42 on a lookup failure. So India s3 is the brittle case and US s3 is the robust case - the asymmetry runs the opposite way for the two countries.
blocking_key_asymmetry.inference_flag: The claim that s3 resolution is field-only is INFERENCE from the code path plus the whole-component requirement. build_profile.py flattens components, so how many 'mh' occurrences sit in a standalone component versus inside a longer one is NOT measurable here.
blocking_key_asymmetry.france_exempt: France has no 2-letter state representation, so this asymmetry does not arise for France at all.
blocking_key_asymmetry.action: NO CHANGE. The dictionary is correct and the corpus is closed; adding a code-based blocking key would add mass with no measured recall problem to fix.

french_bis_form.verdict: The French-shaped fused number+suffix form does NOT exist in train_s3, nor in any train file, for US or India.

bis_is_test_only.note: The bis form arrives with source 2, exactly like the France department-vs-region shift. It is France-test-only.

what_the_train_s3_fused_mass_actually_is.dominant_forms: Indian ordinals (2nd 53858, 1st 50756, 3rd 37164, 4th 24026, 5th 15354) plus Indian society-block flat designations: 1a 7350, 2a 4698, 1b 3378, 3a 3263, 2b 2961, 4a 2472, 5a 2202, 3b 2056
what_the_train_s3_fused_mass_actually_is.classification: Indian flat-designation phenomenon, NOT a French bis phenomenon

keys_py_impact.mechanism: 1a / 1b / 2a are 2 characters. keys.py:42 requires len >= 3 for alph and keys.py:41 requires ^\d+$ for nums, so a 2-char fused token satisfies NEITHER: the house number is dropped from blocking nums (D127) AND the fused token is dropped from alph.
keys_py_impact.why_not: s1 India 26554 and s2 India 51732 are both LARGER than s3's 49331. This is a pre-existing, source-independent issue, not something s3 introduced.
keys_py_impact.action: NO CHANGE. ~23/1k rows on one country; the affected forms are low-entropy (1a, 1b recur across thousands of unrelated addresses) and adding them as blocking keys would mostly add collisions.

house_number_reliability_verdict.verdict: high-precision, low-recall. A reliable key for the ~94% of rows that have one, and a designed-in noise source for exactly the rows the decoy post-filter targets.
data_shows: only 5.2036% of US and 6.8745% of India train_s3 rows have a digit-free address (alpha_only_addr), so ~93-95% of rows carry a usable number
keys.py:41 puts the first three (MAX_NUM = 3) into nums, feeding the kind-2 address-number x word key
numbers are short and highly concentrated: train_s3 US has 676 distinct 3-digit values carrying 1016608 occurrences, a mean of ~1504 rows per value
keys.py:23 CAPS = {0:50,1:50,2:30,3:50,4:20} with S1_MAXCAP = 300 drops over-frequent keys, so the CAP is doing the discriminating; the number is low-entropy and survives only in the tail
house_number_reliability_verdict.inference: decoy_postfilter.py:5-9 states the generator shifts house numbers by a fixed POSITIVE offset (+1,+2,+3,+4,+5,+7,+9,+11,+13,+21) and that 79.8% of same-name US decoys carry one of those offsets vs 0.126% of true US pairs (0.299% India) for the strong offsets. NOT re-measured; the profile holds no pair-level data and cannot verify it.
house_number_reliability_verdict.practical_reading: Trustworthy when the number AGREES; near-worthless when it disagrees by a small POSITIVE amount. Treat a small positive number delta as evidence of a decoy, not a typo. num1_eq (features.py:114) is a 3-way feature, so a missing number is distinguishable from a mismatch.

france_supplement_TEST_ONLY.warning: These are test_* figures, NOT train_* figures. They must never be cited as a train_s3 France figure and are not a substitute for one.
france_supplement_TEST_ONLY.density_comparison: France num_digits/row 1.93-1.97 vs US 3.9792 / India 3.7717 in train_s3 - roughly half the density, consistent with a short leading house number then a long French street name.
france_supplement_TEST_ONLY.denominator_warning: The 0.42% no-digit figure quoted in the work order is test_s1 ONLY. s2/s3 is 3.67-3.79%, about 9x higher. Quoting 0.42% without naming test_s1 repeats the retracted-figure denominator error. The s1/s2/s3 gap mirrors the US alpha_only_addr gap (0.0001% -> 6.1192% -> 5.2036%), so it is a SOURCE artefact, not a France fact.

france_two_char_tokens_test_s3.per_D119: these function words are largely consumed by the whole-component continue at normalize.py:333-335 and are behaviourally harmless

gaps: Component ORDER and house-number position: NOT in the profile. build_profile.py:126-127 lowercases, splits on [,;] and feeds a Counter - no order and no component boundaries retained. Cannot distinguish '175 Boulevard ...' from '... 175'; cannot count leading-number rows. Structural gap in the PROFILE, not in the data. Not estimated.
Whether a state code sits in a standalone comma-component: not measurable, same flattening. This bounds the blocking_key_asymmetry magnitude claim.
Pair-level decoy statistics (79.8% / 0.126% / 0.299%): quoted from decoy_postfilter.py:5-9, NOT re-measured; the profile holds no pair data.
Top-4000 truncation floors: train_s1 182, train_s2 394, train_s3 362, test_s1 166, test_s2 459, test_s3 416. Every 'absent' means 'not in the top 4000', never 'does not occur'.
All token figures are OCCURRENCES, never rows. A token appearing twice in one address counts twice.
Row-level digit co-occurrence is not collected. dig5 and dig6 are independent totals and MUST NOT be added.

new_findings.label: CONFIRMED
new_findings.title: The s3 state-representation shift is BIDIRECTIONAL and COUNTRY-OPPOSITE
new_findings.body: India s1/s2 write the state in full and s3 writes the 2-letter code (12.56 -> 685.22 per 1k). The US does the exact reverse: s1/s2 write the 2-letter code (1027.19 -> 88.46 per 1k) and s3 writes the full name (28.80 -> 787.02 per 1k). D118 measured the India direction only. Source 3 is a different geography encoding, not a compression.
new_findings.evidence: train_s3 India mh 321405 vs maharashtra 24074; train_s3 US texas 294385 vs tx 15282, against train_s1 US tx 133224 vs texas 713

new_findings.label: CONFIRMED (correction to D118)
new_findings.title: Self-map loop exposure is 10,044,348 occurrences, 3.21x the recorded 3,125,112
new_findings.body: D118's 98.00% is an IN_STATES-only statistic. US_STATES runs the other way (5.91% in s3). The true stake is the mass in files that WRITE 2-letter codes, because those have no blocking-key fallback: India s3 3,125,112 + US s1/s2/test_s1/test_s2 6,919,236 = 10,044,348 = 95.27% of all self-map mass. Do not refactor normalize.py:252-254.

new_findings.label: CONFIRMED (structural); impact NOT measurable
new_findings.title: A 2-letter state code can never be a blocking key; India s3 state resolution is field-only with zero fallback
new_findings.body: keys.py:42 requires len >= 3 and keys.py:41 requires ^\d+$; all 51 US and 36 IN canonical values are exactly 2 chars, and none collides with ADDR_GENERIC. The only carrier is state_eq (features.py:114), a 3-way feature not a retrieval route. US s3 writes 'texas' (5 chars) and WOULD retain a blocking token on a lookup failure, so India s3 is the brittle case and US s3 the robust one. No action.

defect_note: No new code defect. The French 'bis' fused-form concern is refuted for train (0 occurrences in any train file); the train_s3 fused mass is Indian flat designations and is a PRE-EXISTING keys.py:41 issue that is LARGER in s1/s2 than s3, so not an s3 regression.

trap.statement: Any France rate computed over a train-file France denominator is meaningless. A train file cannot produce one. France digit / postcode / state rates must be quoted from test_s1/s2/s3, never from a train file, and always with the sub-file named.
trap.this_is_the_retracted_figure_error: The retracted '100% of France rows resolve a state' figure was a test_source1-only denominator (259,452 rows = 15.3119% of 1,694,445 France test rows) presented as a France-wide rate. Its arithmetic summed exactly to the s1 row count, which was the tell.
